characters.summary: Yennefer of Vengerberg is a powerful sorceress who specializes in combat magic, tactical manipulation, and spatial portals. She fights at range using elemental energy, defensive magic barriers, and necromantic rituals when necessary.
weaknesses: Physical vulnerability when her magical barriers fail
limitations: Complex rituals require concentration and time
Vulnerable to physical attack if caught off-guard without a barrier

sources.supports: Magic capabilities, combat style, portal usage, and role in The Witcher 3.

feats.claim: Summoned a massive magical storm during the battle of Skellige
Resurrected a dead creature briefly using forbidden necromancy in Skellige

notableResults.note: Fought alongside Geralt using combat magic and tactical shielding.

conditional.dependsOn: Presence of a recently deceased corpse

campaignTags.claim: Practices powerful chaos magic and combat spells
Casts offensive elemental and defensive magic in combat
Creates spatial portals for instant travel and combat positioning

unknowns: Full extent of her combat power without the constraints of lodge politics or game mechanics.

characters.summary: Yoshi is a versatile dinosaur companion who uses his prehensile tongue to swallow enemies, turning them into throwable eggs or spitting them back out. He is capable of a flutter jump for extended airborne mobility.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to bottomless pits and environmental hazards
Fleeing when startled or taking damage
limitations: Cannot sustain prolonged independent flight without special items

sources.supports: Abilities including tongue attack, egg throwing, flutter jump, and mount mechanics.

feats.claim: Swallowed armored enemies and converted them into projectile eggs
Executed a high flutter jump to clear wide chasms

notableResults.note: Defeated various Koopa forces by swallowing and throwing objects.

campaignTags.claim: Acts as a ridable mount for Mario and other characters
Uses flutter jump to temporarily maintain altitude and cross gaps

unknowns: Biological limits of items swallowed by Yoshi.

characters.continuity: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild / Tears of the Kingdom
characters.summary: Princess Zelda fights primarily using ancient Sheikah technology and magical sealing powers tied to the Triforce of Wisdom. In combat, she directs holy light and constructs barriers to suppress powerful threats.
weaknesses: Awakening her sealing magic requires extreme emotional catalyst or peril
limitations: Power was dormant for years until triggered by mortal peril

sources.supports: Zelda's magical abilities, sealing powers, and history across Breath of the Wild.

notableResults.citation: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
notableResults.note: Locked Ganon in a century-long stalemate at the cost of her freedom.

characters.continuity: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
characters.summary: Transformed into an immortal dragon by swallowing a secret stone, Light Dragon Zelda possesses immense size, flight capabilities, and sacred restorative power radiated from her scales.
weaknesses: Low combat aggression due to loss of human consciousness
limitations: Mindless state prevents tactical human combat decision-making
characters.formDifferences: Changes Zelda from a human spellcaster into an immense, flying sacred dragon with divine restorative properties.

sources.supports: Light Dragon form attributes, flight, sacred healing properties, and origin from Zelda.

feats.claim: Soared above the clouds of Hyrule for millennia carrying the Master Sword
feats.citation: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom

campaignTags.claim: Flies continuously through the sky using large dragon wings
Exceeds 8 feet in height/length as a massive serpentine dragon
Radiates sacred energy capable of restoring vitality

unknowns: Whether her dragon form retains any proactive offensive combat instincts.

characters.continuity: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
characters.summary: Sheik is a disguised persona of Princess Zelda trained in stealth, acrobatics, and martial arts. She fights using stealth tactics, throwing knives, smoke bombs, and the harp.
weaknesses: Light physical frame compared to heavy brute opponents
limitations: Relies on surprise and agility rather than raw destructive power
characters.formDifferences: Transforms Princess Zelda into an agile, stealthy martial artist equipped for direct skirmishes and espionage.

sources.supports: Sheik's stealth abilities, martial arts, magic harp, and escape techniques.

feats.claim: Disappeared instantly from locked environments using smoke bombs

notableResults.citation: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
